# CoreSpotlight

**Symbols:** 8.3% of Apple's iOS API (69 of 828, exact) · **Rows:** 4: 1 ✅ 1 🟡 2 ❌ · **iOS:** 9.0+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [App extensions & system integration](../COVERAGE.md#system) · **Apple:** [CoreSpotlight](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/corespotlight) · **Issues:** [`area:system`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Asystem)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** a per-app plist index that the home screen's search reads.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Spotlight (`CSSearchableItem`), `NSUserActivity` indexing | 🟡 | ≤17 | CoreSpotlight `CSSearchableIndex` index/delete (ids, domains, all), `CSSearchableItemAttributeSet` (title, description, keywords); activities with `isEligibleForSearch`; the home screen's Spotlight finds them and continues `CSSearchableItemActionType` / the activity in the app. Tested (homescreen, HelloScenes). `CSSearchQuery` is a stub (no results). Missing: `CSSearchQuery` returns nothing, about 15 of the attribute set properties, `CSUserQuery`, `CSSearchableIndexDelegate` |
| Objective-C interface (`CoreSpotlight.framework`): `CSSearchableIndex`, `CSSearchableItem`, `CSSearchableItemAttributeSet` (`initWithItemContentType:` and the common attributes), `CSSearchQuery` (stub), `CSSearchableItemActionType` and the other constants, `CSIndexErrorDomain` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: headers over the Swift overlay's classes (Apple's Objective-C names). Not from Objective-C: `initWithContentType:` (`UTType` has no Objective-C class on isim). Tested (HelloServicesObjC, tests/ui/test_services_objc.py) |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 17 and earlier) | ❌ | ≤17 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `CSCustomAttributeKey`, `CSImportExtension`, `CSIndexExtensionRequestHandler`, `CSLocalizedString`, `CSPerson`, `CSSearchQueryContext`, `CSSearchQueryError`, `CSSearchQueryError.Code`, `CSSuggestion`, `CSUserQueryContext` (10 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 27) | ❌ | 27.0 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `ContactResolver`, `CoreSpotlightSource`, `CSSearchableIndexDescription`, `CustomStage`, `FileSource`, `ResolvedContact`, `ScoredSearchableItem`, `SearchableItem`, `SearchableItemAttribute`, `SearchCount`, `SearchPipelineData`, `SearchPipelineDataType`, `SearchResultsTable`, `SearchSource`, `SearchStatistic`, `SearchTextResult`, `SpotlightSearchTool`, `SpotlightSearchTool.Configuration` (18 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
